name: Aru Douwa Kara no Dasshutsu ~Alice Hen~
original_name: ある童話からの脱出～アリス編～
source:
Alice, a saucy young boy who liked to wear dresses, 
read her novel in the shade of the tree. 

Just then... the world went all curvy, and Alice was lost in a fantastical forest. 

Seeking a way home, she met a flamboyant cat and a brilliantly deranged hatter who decided she simply must see the queen. 

On their way, the mad hatter took a fancy to Alice, 
and quite suddenly locked her in a little room. 

"My pretty Alice... Let me give you a chance. Escape from this room and I'll send you on your way to her majesty. 
Otherwise... you become my plaything. What do you say?" 

"... Fine by me! I can get out of here in two shakes of a rabbit's tail."

Help Alice solve the riddle of the room and escape this insane world! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144704.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“爱丽丝，一个喜欢穿裙子的俏皮小男孩，
在树荫下读她的小说。

就在那时……世界变得弯曲，爱丽丝迷失在一片奇幻的森林里。

在寻找回家的路上，她遇到了一只华丽的猫和一个非常疯狂的帽匠，他们决定她一定要见女王。

途中，疯帽子看上了爱丽丝，
突然把她锁在一个小房间里。

“我漂亮的爱丽丝……让我给你一个机会。逃离这个房间，我会送你去见女王陛下。” 
不然……你就成了我的玩物。你说什么？” 

“……我没问题！我只要摇动两下兔子尾巴就可以离开这里。”

帮助爱丽丝解开房间之谜，逃离这个疯狂的世界！
